title: Dan Barker (Founder, Klasma) finds the Leeroy Jenkins joke in chapter 9 — 'The +2 Pauldrons of Invincibility'
summary: Dan Barker, who wrote about the book shaping two live decisions at Klasma a few days earlier, reports a different kind of find: a World of Warcraft gag buried in chapter 9, where a section titled 'The +2 Pauldrons of Invincibility' warns about over-relying on indestructible pauldrons.
blockquote:
I laughed out loud when Eric Ries referenced Leeroy Jenkins in his new book, Incorruptible. There's a section in chapter 9 titled "The +2 Pauldrons of Invincibility" warning about the risks of over-relying on indestructible pauldrons. 

Hilarious and well played! 

Stick to the plan!
